manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: A tossed ball and a ball released from rest at the top share the same motion afterwards. Velocity is zero at the top, but acceleration stays -g.
manifest.description: Two lanes show a tossed ball and a second ball held by a gate at the apex height. At the top the gate opens and both fall together. Arrows show velocity and acceleration.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At top jumps to the shared release.
